translations.text: I confess to God almighty and to our Lady Saint Mary, and to Saint Michael and Saint Peter and all God's saints, and to you, his messenger.
For I am sinful in thoughts and in deeds, in words and in works;
in fornication, in theft, in slander, in envy, in anger, in gluttony, in drunkenness, in cursing and in swearing.
Of all these sins, and of many others, I confess to almighty God and all his saints, and to you, his messenger.
I confess to God almighty, because I am sinful, that I did not keep or honour holy Sunday and other holy days as God has commanded and as was my duty.
I confess to God almighty that through the laziness of my body I did not attend my church as I should, nor listen to my vespers, my matins or my mass, as God has commanded and as was my duty.
I confess to God almighty that in church I thought wrongful things and held wrongful talk with another person, so that I would not listen to God's praise and did not let others listen.
I confess to God almighty that I received the holy sacrament with an unclean body, in that I was not purified as God has commanded and as was my duty.
I confess to God almighty that I did not feed the hungry, did not give drink to the thirsty, and did not visit the sick, as God has commanded and as was my duty.
I confess to God almighty that I did not invite needy people into my house, nor give them food or drink, or a place to lie or a bed, as God has commanded and as was my duty.
I confess to God that I did not love or honour my father and my mother and my other nearest kin as God has commanded and as was my duty.
I confess that I did not teach my godchildren as I pledged to when I became their sponsor. I confess to God that I harmed people whom I should not have harmed.
I confess to God that I did not pay my tithe or look after my lord's affairs as God has commanded and as was my duty.
All that I have now named, whether I did it knowingly, whether it befell me through drunkenness, or whether it befell me in some other way: whatever I with this [?]
